brief: A 9-second product launch title: a logo mark made of three overlapping circles (teal, coral, gold) flies in from three different directions with an overshoot and locks together; then the wordmark 'Lumen' rises letter by letter beneath it; then the tagline 'Light, measured.' fades in below; finally the whole lockup scales down by about 10% and holds.
checks: The three logo circles are teal, coral, and gold respectively.
The circles overlap each other to form a single lockup with no gaps.
Each circle flies in from a different direction and clearly overshoots before settling.
After the overshoot the circles lock together and remain stationary as a group.
The wordmark 'Lumen' appears beneath the logo, letter‑by‑letter, with each letter rising into place.
The letters of 'Lumen' are evenly spaced and horizontally aligned under the logo.
The tagline 'Light, measured.' fades in below the wordmark after the wordmark is fully formed.
The tagline text is legible and has sufficient contrast against the background.
Once the tagline is visible, the entire lockup scales down by roughly 10% and then holds still.
The final hold lasts at least 0.5 seconds before the video ends.
No element ever touches or crosses the outer frame edges.
All motions ease in and out (show acceleration/deceleration) rather than moving at a constant speed.
There is visible movement or change in every second of the 9‑second clip (no dead air).
The video contains no visual glitches, flicker, overlapping text, or rendering artifacts.
